up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records where organism is 'Mus musculus', ordered by met_id ASC. Join metabolism.substrate_record_id to compound_records.record_id, then to molecule_dictionary.molregno for the substrate compound name (pref_name), and to compound_structures.molregno for the canonical SMILES as the substrate structure. Also join metabolism.drug_record_id to compound_records and molecule_dictionary for the parent compound name. Return the canonical SMILES, substrate compound name, parent compound name, met_conversion, pathway_key, and enzyme_name. Limit the result to 200 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  md_sub.pref_name AS compound_name,
  md_par.pref_name AS parent_compound_name,
  m.met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion,
  m.pathway_key AS pathway,
  m.enzyme_name AS enzyme
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md_par ON cr_par.molregno = md_par.molregno
WHERE m.organism = 'Mus musculus'
ORDER BY m.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200
